name: xcov
expr: cn = xcov(x,y); cb = xcov(x,y,'biased'); cu = xcov(x,y,'unbiased'); cc = xcov(x,y,'coeff');
comment: Sig c=xcov(x,y,scaleopt): cross-covariance of mean-removed signals with scaling. zero-lag is index 5 (length 2N-1=9). 'none' c(5)=5 raw; 'biased' divides every lag by N=5 -> c(5)=1, c(4)=-1.56, c(6)=0.6; 'unbiased' divides lag m by (N-|m|) -> c(5)=1, c(3)=1.26667, c(7)=-2.53333; 'coeff' divides by sqrt(Cxx0*Cyy0)=sqrt(22.8*10) -> c(5)=0.331133. numkit previously ignored scaleopt entirely (returned raw for all). Fixed in convolution.cpp.
